title: Capital City Music Hall

services.name: Dance class
services.desc: Savage Cabaret: Burlesque Invasion brings an intimate night of seductive dance, outrageous costumes, vintage glamour, variety and beautifully strange performances to Capital City Music Hall. Your extraterrestrial lineup features Margot Starlux, Jewelissa, Ashantidoll, Caresse Deville and Fox E. Martin, with Peetie Esdee serving as stage kitten and Kali Coutour commanding the evening as host. Reserve a table, settle in with a drink and experience burlesque the way it was intended to be - up close, unapologetic and very much
